note: Production clips drafted from silhouette continuity and checked by eye against the contact sheet. Names describe the look of the frames; they are not parsed game ANI definitions. Clips with `sheet` are drawn from one pose sheet (pose_sheets.json) instead of video.

clips.name: 站姿收手
clips.motion: She widens her stance, brings a hand up to her chest, then lowers it and stands with feet apart.

clips.name: 抬手瞄准
clips.motion: From a wide stance she turns and swings one arm out straight to the right, hand forward.

clips.name: 抬腿转身末帧
clips.motion: Facing the camera she lifts one knee high under the gown, turns on her standing leg with one arm raised bent above her head and the other in front of her chest. Her face stays visible.

clips.name: 弓步指向
clips.motion: In a wide stance she points forward with one arm and raises it upward.

clips.name: 俯身蓄力
clips.motion: She leans forward in a wide lunge, both hands low in front of her, swaying a little as she readies herself.

clips.name: 双臂平举
clips.motion: In a long stance she throws both arms straight out to the left and right, holds, then pulls them back in front of her chest.

clips.name: 屈膝站定
clips.motion: She stands in a low wide crouch with both knees deeply bent so she is much shorter than her full height, one arm raised out to the left with an open hand and the other hand at her waist.

clips.name: 前倾挥手
clips.motion: She lunges forward with both arms swept out ahead, then rises and stands straight.

clips.name: 倒地蹲起
clips.motion: She lies on her back on the ground, gets up to a low crouch, then rises to a half stand.

clips.name: 跳跃
clips.motion: She is in mid-air with knees tucked and her body curled forward, then lands in a low crouch.

clips.name: 飞踢
clips.motion: She drops low, then throws a high horizontal kick with her body almost flat, spinning with both legs out.

clips.name: 高踢
clips.motion: She winds up on one leg and swings the other leg high and straight forward, then lowers it in a long kick.

clips.name: 朝天高踢
clips.motion: She stands on one straight leg and kicks the other leg straight up overhead, her whole body tilted far to the left with her head low at waist height and one arm hanging down. The gown falls away from the raised leg.

clips.name: 翻身倒立
clips.motion: She springs forward with her body curled, then flips into a full handstand, upside down, with both arms straight down, her head near the ground, and her legs straight up above her. The gown hangs down around her.

clips.name: 持续瞄准
clips.motion: She stands in a firm stance with both arms held straight out to the right at chest height, with tiny recoil movements.
